value.rationale: The 4-cube is both the first degree-four Boolean cube and a natural 4-by-4 toroidal lattice. The theorem completely determines a nontrivial 30-type geometric recurrent decomposition, fixed/two-cycle basin sizes, and a sharp jump from maximum entrance one on Q3 to four on Q4; late transients are confined to fixed-point basins. These coupled natural invariants are more than an arbitrary narrow statistic or routine corollary of eventual period two.
